Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing conditions for video monitoring in public schools.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to video monitoring in public schools; and addinga new section to chapter 28A.150 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.150RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Before the commencement of video monitoring in any publicschool: (a) All certificated and classified staff assigned to the schoolshall be informed, in writing, that the school and its occupants may besubject to video monitoring; (b) Written notices shall be posted outside of every room statingthat the room and its occupants may be subject to video monitoring; and (c) Written notices shall be posted at all building entrancesstating that rooms within the building, and their occupants, may besubject to video monitoring. (2) As used in this section, "video monitoring" means therecording of a series of visual images by any device, electronic orotherwise. p. 1 HB 1262 (3) The school district shall preserve the original of any videomonitoring for not less than six years from the date of the monitoring. (4) This section does not authorize video monitoring in a manner that is inconsistent with, or violates, chapter 9.73 RCW. (5) This section does not apply to residential education programsunder chapter 28A.190 RCW or education programs for juvenile inmatesunder chapter 28A.193 RCW. (6) This section does not apply to the recording of a series ofvisual images that is directed by school staff, students, or parents,as part of instructional activities.
